warnings.precise_source_claim: The prose says the decision coefficient is better when closer to 1, and it treats the risk term as a measured penalty.
warnings.warning: Equation (3) is a ratio of residual sums of squares, so closer to 1 means a worse fit, the opposite of the sentence. Equation (5) sums a term that does not depend on its index, so the risk term is identically zero as printed. The skill must keep both the sentence and the formula and must not teach either as a working definition.

warnings.precise_source_claim: The objective penalizes risk through S_j over a 30-day window.
warnings.warning: The left side carries subscript j and the right side never uses j. Rewriting the summand as A_j would invent a formula the page does not print. As printed the penalty vanishes and the objective collapses to raw assets.

warnings.precise_source_claim: The strategy uses only prices known on the day of the trade.
